title: Analysis code for: A hypoxia-associated SPP1+ macrophage state distinguishes paired precursor and invasive lung adenocarcinoma lesions
description:
Analysis scripts, pre-specified and hash-locked analysis plans, and figure source data for a public-data study of the precursor-to-invasive transition in lung adenocarcinoma. No new data were generated; all datasets analysed are public and are listed in the paper's Data availability statement.

Code (scripts/, figures/) is released under the MIT License; text and data (plans/, other_documents/, source_data/, README.md, CHECKSUMS.tsv) under CC BY 4.0.
